test.message: I've been waiting four months for ₹80,000 of my own money and I'm completely stressed. I can't handle this anymore.
test.answer: I'm sorry this has been so stressful, and a long wait for your own money is a fair thing to be upset about. I've asked the Assistant Registrar (Accounts) to contact you personally rather than leaving this to the portal. If the stress is affecting your sleep or wellbeing, the institute's counselling and wellness support is there for faculty too, and talking to someone you trust can help.
